opus_4_7_tokenizer_risk: Claude Opus 4.7 and later Opus models, plus Claude Sonnet 5, use a newer tokenizer that produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. Sonnet 4.6 and earlier use the previous tokenizer.
pricing_notes: Sonnet 5 introductory pricing of $2/$10 per MTok (input/output) is in effect through 2026-08-31; standard pricing of $3/$15 applies from 2026-09-01. CostPassport uses the standard (post-intro) rate for estimates so figures do not silently under-estimate after the intro window (see D-033).
Since 2026-06-15, programmatic Claude Code usage on Pro/Max subscriptions draws from API-rate credit pools, so API-rate estimates apply to subscription agentic usage as well.

Opus 4.8 and Opus 4.7 offer a research-preview fast mode at premium rates ($10/$50 and $30/$150 per MTok); CostPassport estimates use standard Opus pricing, not fast mode. Fast mode is not available with the Batch API.
Batch API applies a 50% discount on both input and output tokens; cache reads (hits) are billed at 10% of the base input price.
